controlled_state.message: TextInput is controlled when value is set, so the snippet uses useState and onChange to keep the field editable.

default.message: Default shows the common labeled input setup with name, placeholder, and state-backed value.

with_error.message: With Error displays validation copy below the field while preserving the entered value.

disabled.message: Disabled keeps the label and placeholder visible while preventing edits.

required.message: Required combines required with requiredIndicator so the label communicates the requirement.
